title: Stream transcript (valid): SESSION_INIT followed by ordered DATA_WRITE entries
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT followed by two DATA_WRITE filesystem entries with monotonically increasing sequence numbers. Validates that ordered data entries are accepted after session establishment. Does not require live TCP/QUIC transport.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
Entries carry seq=0 (SESSION_INIT), seq=1, seq=2 in strict order.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
